speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for coming in. You mentioned generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to help narrow this down, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes (jaundice), dark urine, or pale stools recently?

REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Liver_Function_Tests, Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hemoglobin: 11.5 g/dL, Leukocyte_Count: 7500/mm3, Platelet_Count: 280,000/mm3, Na: 138 mEq/L, K: 4.7 mEq/L, Bilirubin_Total: 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct: 0.9 mg/dL, Alkaline_Phosphatase: 460 U/L, AST: 75 U/L, ALT: 78 U/L

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) or Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC). The presence of scleral icterus, severe pruritus, and fatigue with an incorrect previous diagnosis of pneumonia strongly suggests an intrahepatic cholestatic disorder. I will review your recent liver function test results to confirm elevated alkaline phosphatase and bilirubin levels. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests (specifically Alkaline Phosphatase, Bilirubin, GGT), Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA), Anti-Smooth Muscle Antibody (ASMA).
